description.content: Recent changes across all item types in Pipedrive (deals, persons, etc).
Returns data about all recent changes occurred after the given timestamp.

query.description: (Required) The timestamp in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
Multiple selection of item types to include in the query (optional)

response.name: List of items changed since "since_timestamp"

info.name: Pipedrive API v1 Activities Recents API

description.content: Activities are appointments/tasks/events on a calendar that can be associated with a deal, a lead, a person and an organization. Activities can be of different type (such as call, meeting, lunch or a custom type - see ActivityTypes object) and can be assigned to a particular user. Note that activities can also be created without a specific date/time.
